verdict.rationale: Deepgram publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200). It also offers step-by-step quickstarts in Python, JavaScript, C#, and Go, plus runnable starter apps on GitHub, which together give a reference and runnable example code. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with in-browser 'try it' or runnable request execution. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer/playground, runnable examples embedded in the reference itself, independent corroboration.
